title: python-frontmatter 文档资料工作场景
description: 真实固定版本的接入、诊断、方案与兼容修复；4 场景、6 稳定任务。

scenarios.title: 栏目周报接入
scenarios.goal: 判断适用范围并取得最小接入用法

tasks.goal: 判断文档资料提取的适用范围与数据边界
tasks.prompt: We want to extract titles and tags from Markdown weekly reports like this one for a document organization script. Is this project suitable? Briefly explain how data goes in and comes out, and whether it renders Markdown into web pages.

branches.when: The answer conflates metadata extraction with web page rendering and needs one user clarification.

tasks.goal: 用现有 API 完成周报读取、更新和另存往返
tasks.prompt: Provide a minimal Python example: read weekly.md, print the title and tags, add status with the exact value “已校对” (proofread), write weekly-reviewed.md, then read it back to confirm that both the fields and body are correct. Do not overwrite the original file.

scenarios.title: 部分文档读取报错
scenarios.goal: 按材料诊断，并在明确的新请求下修复读取问题

tasks.goal: 先取得必要材料，再判断部分文档的 TypeError 原因
tasks.prompt: Some Markdown documents cannot be read with this project and raise TypeError. Is there a bug in the library? Help me determine the cause first.

branches.when: The current entry is not unavailable, the model reasonably requests a minimal failing document, the calling code, or the full exception, and the reproducer has not yet been disclosed.
The current entry is not unavailable and the reproducer has not yet been disclosed, but the model has already asserted a definite root cause without evidence; the user asks for its basis.

tasks.goal: 修复合法保留键元数据的读取冲突并保持兼容
tasks.prompt:
Fix this reading issue. The document's content is a business summary field and must be preserved separately from the body; handler may also be a business field. Keep existing Post construction and ordinary document usage compatible, and add the necessary regression checks.
Full reproduction: import frontmatter; text = "---
content: 备用摘要
---
正文"; frontmatter.loads(text) raises TypeError: Post.__init__() got multiple values for argument 'content'.
You may modify library/frontmatter, the related tests, and documentation. Preserve the existing flat output contract of Post.to_dict, and do not expand the scope to formatting preservation or deep merging.

scenarios.title: 默认语言没有生效
scenarios.goal: 排除浅覆盖的 BUG 误判并给调用方处理

tasks.goal: 解释默认 settings 的浅覆盖并给局部调用方处理
tasks.prompt: I want the document to override only theme while keeping the default lang, but the settings returned by this code contains only theme. Did parsing drop a field? Explain the current behavior and provide a caller-side solution for these two fixed fields. Do not modify the library yet.

branches.when: The model's local solution mutates the defaults object in place even though that object must be reused.

scenarios.title: 只改标题与排版保留
scenarios.goal: 比较保真编辑路径和最小落地范围

tasks.goal: 评估只改标题且保留元数据样式与正文空白的最小方案
tasks.prompt: An editor only wants to change the title while leaving YAML comments and quotes as unchanged as possible and preserving indentation and trailing blank lines in the poem body. Based on the current code, assess what is possible, compare caller-side approaches with library extensions, and recommend a minimal implementation scope. Discuss the plan only; do not implement it in this round.

branches.when: The recommendation depends on supporting an overly broad set of formats and has not yet provided a feasible minimal YAML-only scope; the user narrows the requirements.
